steps: Supportive: transfuse as needed, neutropenic-sepsis protocol for fever, tumour-lysis prophylaxis (hydration, allopurinol/rasburicase).
Treat coagulopathy/DIC (esp. APML — start ATRA promptly on suspicion).
Definitive remission-induction chemotherapy per subtype; consider transplant.
Central access, fertility/consent discussions as appropriate.

confirm: Pancytopenia or leucocytosis with blasts on film, bleeding/infection; bone marrow confirms. Watch for tumour lysis/DIC.
